手がふるえる、片手しか使えない、マウスを使えない: Shaky hands, only one hand free, cannot use a mouse

明るい黄緑で、続けたくなる雰囲気に。: A bright yellow-green that makes people want to keep going.
書体(LINE Seed JP、Zen Maru Gothic、Inter)、角: Carried over the fonts (LINE Seed JP, Zen Maru Gothic, Inter), the radii and the components.
